mission: Root cause of the #140 staging verification timeouts (owner request 2026-10-16): the staging verifier's masked failure message names the stage in progress (fixed labels such as 'browser warm-up /prints/5661'), never the provider or driver text. Staging only; no deployment, data write, secret, setting, workflow or collector change.

impacts.reason: Adds STEP/step()/failure_message(); main() and browser_check() set fixed stage labels before each check. Checks, order, timeouts and pass/fail conditions are unchanged; only the failure text gains 'during <stage>'. Not in either collector's import graph.
The masked message names the stage and drops the error text (no token or URL leaks).
